name: Eyelash curler

lead: An eyelash curler is a hand tool with a curved rubber pad and metal frame that clamps and bends the upper lashes into a curl. Heated versions are used after mascara.
It widens the eyes visually and is a long-standing makeup tool. Clinical literature is sparse and consists of injury case reports.

paras: The clamp bends lashes into a curve around the pad, and the shape holds as hair keratin sets. Heated curlers use warmth to retain the curl longer.

Misuse can pinch eyelid skin and break lashes, and a case report describes serious eye injury from a curler. Curling after mascara can pull out lashes, and heated tools should be used carefully. The curl lasts only a few hours.
